items.q: Anyhow, Ray Avery now has the label. And he didn't do anything shady. He is one of the beautiful people also.

ctx.x: Ray Avery has taken that name. We thought that because of the partner that didn't do right, we had lost title to it, so it... Anyhow, Ray Avery now has the label. And he didn't do anything shady. He is one of the beautiful people also.
Right. He has taken over your catalogue or just the name?
